citation: Jain et al. (2026) answer that bottom heating with a realistic power-law rheology does give domes over upwellings, and that the small isolated cells at the margins are localised plumes with about 40 m of relief
claims: - **Relief.** Cell centres stand tens of metres above the edges (Trowbridge et al. 2016); 100 to 150 m in the larger cells (Jain et al. 2026). Heat flow over upwellings is nearly twice the mean and near zero over downwellings.
